reply_text:
Pree, it's ticket **#88412**.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 July 2025. It was the Tier 2 support escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing on the BOL barcode scan at **Tansleigh Packaging**. The night shift lead said the scanner app hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

That's the only source I found. I couldn't see any ticket records in the files you have access to, so I haven't checked the number against the support system itself. Tobias first wrote "TP", and that day's thread sorted out that he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. #88412 is the packaging ticket, so make sure the deck doesn't tie it to the parcel account.
